# Itqan Solutions

> Itqan Solutions (ITQAN Solutions) is a custom software and digital marketing company based in Maadi, Cairo, Egypt, serving businesses in Egypt and the GCC. It builds ERP, POS and business-management systems, web and mobile apps, business automation, and runs B2B marketing and creative work. Its product line is Tashgheel: CRM, Restaurants (F&B), Clinics, Retail and Services.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://itqansolutions.org/): company overview
- [Services](https://itqansolutions.org/services.html): software engineering, digital solutions, marketing and creative, business automation
- [Tashgheel Real Estate CRM](https://itqansolutions.org/tashgheel-crm.html): real estate CRM for developers and brokers in Egypt: leads, units, reservations, installments, commissions (app: https://crm.itqansolutions.org)
- [Tashgheel General CRM](https://itqansolutions.org/tashgheel-general-crm.html): CRM and sales management for companies in Egypt: customers, leads, deals, quotations, invoices, inventory, targets (app: https://crm.itqansolutions.org)
- [Tashgheel F&B](https://itqansolutions.org/tashgheel-restaurants.html): restaurant POS and management system: tables, kitchen display, QR ordering, delivery, recipe costing, stock (app: https://fb.itqansolutions.org)
- [Tashgheel Clinics](https://itqansolutions.org/tashgheel-clinics.html): clinic and aesthetic center management: patients, appointments, doctor schedules, sessions, stock, payments (app: https://tashgheelclinics.itqansolutions.org)
- [Tashgheel Retail](https://itqansolutions.org/tashgheel-retail.html): retail POS and inventory management system
- [Tashgheel Services](https://itqansolutions.org/tashgheel-services.html): management system for service businesses
- [Case Studies](https://itqansolutions.org/portfolio.html): selected client work
- [About](https://itqansolutions.org/about.html): who we are
- [Insights (blog)](https://itqansolutions.org/blog.html): articles on ERP, POS, AI for SMEs, digital transformation and B2B marketing in the Middle East
- [Contact](https://itqansolutions.org/contact.html): request a demo or a quote
